text:
maria: Quick sync ask — cross-team owners, where are we on the v2 endpoint rollout? Need owners for: canary window next week, SDK header changes, proxy passthrough, and runtime fallback behavior. Also listing any blockers.

raj: I can take routing + canary config. Need the traffic slices and models list to size the slice. @sasha will you confirm runtime accepts the v2 header semantics?

sasha: Yep — runtime will honor `X-Redwood-API-Version: 2` and prefer the new token budgeting path. If the model rejects due to kv-cache mismatch we'll automatically fall back to the legacy variant (same weights). Planning a small shim if clients still send the old header.

jeff: Infra note: proxy needs header passthrough + an extra /healthz check for v2 routes. Will also add a flag to reject requests missing api_version in strict mode. I can push the proxy config by Tues EOD if no surprises.

olga: I'll update SDK changelog + examples. We'll add a client option `api_version="v2"` and keep backward-compatible default for one release. Example snippet for docs:
```js
// JS SDK example
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiVersion: 'v2' });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```

maria: Thanks — couple quick q's: 1) Deprecation timeline for v1? 2) Who owns telemetry/alerts for regressions when we flip traffic?

raj: Deprec timeline: soft-deprec in 8 weeks (announce), hard-deprec in 16 weeks. We will keep compat shims for at least one hard-deprec cycle.

sasha: I can own runtime regressions and smoke tests. Will add eval prompts to catch prompt-format regressions, and sanity-check output length distributions.

jeff: I'll own infra alerts for 500s/latency spikes tied to v2 routes. Need a small perf smoke suite before canary. Can we run a 1h load test with canonical prompts?

maria: Action item asks:
- raj: create canary slices + list models (due Fri)
- sasha: add smoke/eval suite + fallback test matrix (due Fri)
- jeff: prod proxy change + alert rules (ETA Tues EOD)
- olga: SDK canary publish + docs (ETA Mon)

raj: created PR 4921 for routing; small note in the PR about cookie/affinity.

sasha: proposing two canary windows: Wed 09:00-11:00 PST (low traffic) or Thu 18:00-20:00 PST (backup). Prefer Wed.

jeff: Wed works for infra. We'll hold the rollout behind a feature flag and monitor.

olga: I'll do a limited npm tag `beta-v2` and add a sample migration guide (short checklist).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy-config-4921 -> staging at 1766667850, prod flag flip pending manual approval.

maria: Perfect. Final ask — please drop any blockers here before EOD so we can lock the schedule. If no blockers, I'll post the cross-team canary announcement and invite SRE on-call. :thumbsup:

raj: No blockers from routing side.

sasha: One known risk: a small set of older quantized model builds have different kv layout. I'll add an allowlist and fallback mapping in the runtime shim.

jeff: I might need a short ops window to roll proxy config if certs rotate; will ping infra-ops if that happens.

olga: No blockers for SDK — will coordinate release notes with docs.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. I'll file the canary announcement and tag owners. Ping me if anything changes. :spiral_calendar:
